'''Halmad''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in [[Quelii sector/Legends|Quelii sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==Geography==
Located near the [[Vahaba asteroid belt]] and [[Selaggis VI]], Halmad was a trade center at the hub of several [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperroutes]]. Its [[Mining/Legends|mining]] industry failed roughly between [[200 BBY/Legends|200 BBY]] and [[100 BBY/Legends|100 BBY]] but the location retained its importance due to the hyperspace routes.<ref name="Iron Fist" />

One of the planet's most reputed exports was [[Halmad Prime]], the most expensive grain [[Alcohol/Legends|alcohol]] produced on Halmad, only available for purchase on-planet through the [[Black market/Legends|black market]].<ref name="Iron Fist" />

Halmad was also the site of the [[Quelii Sector Academy]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

==History==
When the [[Ciutric Hegemony]] seceded to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], many [[Axxila/Legends|Axxila]] population, known as the [[Free Axxilans]], fled their planet and relocated on Halmad.<ref name="TEGtW" />

In the years following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], Halmad was located near [[Zsinj]] [[Zsinj's Empire|space]], but still controlled by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. In [[7 ABY/Legends|7.5 ABY]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the planet was chosen by [[Wraith Squadron]]&mdash;a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] squadron&mdash;as the target for their raids while disguised as a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] group called the [[Hawk-bat Independent Space Force]]. During one such [[Halmad campaign|raid]], several [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE Interceptors]] were stolen from [[Victory Base]], an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] base located on the planet. In another battle above, Wraith [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Ton Phanan]] was shot down and died of his injuries despite a rescue attempt by his best friend [[Garik Loran]].<ref name="Iron Fist" />
